description: Writes a json_results output (predictions, detections, metrics) to a destination path.

path.description: Where to save the results file (or folder): pick the system, then a folder (Browse) or type a path. A file output goes into the chosen folder under its own name, or to exactly the path you type if it isn't an existing folder (end it with / to make a new folder). A folder output replaces the chosen folder's contents. 'My node' works only for runs on your own node.
